notes:
Adds automatic HP-preset configuration.

  • On first load in a world, the module detects the game system (game.system.id) and applies the matching HP preset automatically, so it no longer always defaults to D&D 5e. Direct system-id matches work out of the box; explicit aliases are included for Pathfinder 1e (pf1) and Tales of the Valiant / Black Flag (black-flag). A deliberate manual preset choice is preserved.
